lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So you go back. [pause] With the old man's spare charger. And a cup of tea.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [careful] Size... all cats... one.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Un-fly... the bus.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You bring back every flying thing. Every giant thing. Every Granny. [pause] Well. Almost every Granny.

lines.speaker: GRANNY
lines.text: [delighted] Leave me fast, sweetie! I've never been early before!

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.text: [touched] A sticky note? [pause] From YOU? [pause] Oh, it's official now.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And then... Brick.

lines.speaker: BRICK
lines.text: [quiet, embarrassed] ...Are you gonna leave me in here?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [softly] Un-jail Brick. [pause] Hey. Why do you always take my lunch?

lines.speaker: BRICK
lines.text: [small, sad] ...Because then you have to talk to me. [pause] Nobody else does.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: [softly] Oh.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [warm] You know you could just... sit with us?

lines.speaker: BRICK
lines.text: [hopeful, gruff] ...Can I still have the cookie?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [laughs] HALF the cookie.

lines.speaker: BRICK
lines.text: [smiling for the first time] ...Deal.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.text: [warm] One last thing. The panel can keep one command for you. Forever. Any command you want.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You could be fast forever. Big forever. Never picked last again.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You think about it... for a long time.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: [calm] Admin rights... removed. [pause] Thanks for playing.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.text: [proud, warm] Hm. [pause] In two thousand years... you're only the second person to type that.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [curious] Who was the first?

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.text: [winks] Me.
